subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five public memory role slots and per-agent overrides as its long-term memory plugin contract?
rationale: The taxonomy, fallback precedence, migration window, and SDK role metadata are durable product and compatibility choices that tests cannot settle without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the role-slot architecture
options.body: Adopt the proposed taxonomy after the UI/runtime mismatch and exact-head proof gates are resolved.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Expose only roles with complete invocation and control surfaces, deferring the remaining roles until their protocols are concrete.

options.title: Keep composition plugin-owned
options.body: Use a smaller generic capability or memory-orchestrator plugin rather than five new core role slots.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the role-slot architecture
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed taxonomy after the UI/runtime mismatch and exact-head proof gates are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest identified owner for the current Control UI half of the contract; broader plugin API sponsorship should also include the relevant plugin-history owners.
